summary: The EmploymentApplicationDocument is a class and a series of procedures within the HSPnet system aimed at managing documents related to employment applications. It includes functionalities for adding, retrieving, validating, and deleting documents, such as resumes and photos, associated with employment applications.
purpose: To manage employment application documents, including operations like addition, removal, retrieval, and validation of different types of documents associated with employment applications within the HSPnet system.

fields.name: EmploymentApplicationID
fields.description: Identifier for the associated employment application.

fields.name: TypeCodeID
fields.description: Identifier for the type of document.

fields.name: TypeComments
fields.description: Additional comments regarding the type of document.

fields.name: FileSize
fields.description: Size of the document file in bytes.

fields.name: FileTypeAlt
fields.description: Alternative type of the document file (for localization purposes).

fields.name: UpdateDate
fields.description: Date when the document was last updated.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: Identifier of the user who performed the last update.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Last name of the person associated with the document.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: First name of the person associated with the document.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name of the person associated with the document.

fields.name: UpdatedDetails
fields.description: Details about the document's last update, including user name and agency information.

fields.name: Anonymous
fields.description: Flag indicating if the document is anonymous.

fields.name: UploadedByStudent
fields.description: Flag indicating if the document was uploaded by the student.

business_rules: If document type is required but missing, add an error message.
If file URL or file path is blank, add an error message.
validations: Ensure FileURL and FilePath are not blank.
conditions: Differentiate document types by using magic numbers (e.g., -1 for anonymous resume).
Append comments to TypeCode if non-blank.
system_behavior: Retrieve documents using specified procedures based on IDs and parameters.
Remove documents and associated records following the defined procedures.
exceptions: Ignore exceptions during file and directory deletion.
